records.issue_text: InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:239 copies existing query results under a fresh revision, potentially republishing stale organization results if an IDP update invalidates the cache between reading query and obtaining loaded. Preserve and validate the original query revision, or reload results before merging.
records.rationale: The finding describes a race condition in the getForLogin method.
